case_1_breakdown.description: Priority van EV_025 breaks down on route; standby NP van EV_005 promoted with urgent 32 kWh requirement and 15:30 deadline.

case_2_driver_unavailable.description: Driver absence delays EV_030 departure by +2h (laxity increases, triggering safe-release for incoming urgent EV_038).

case_3_roster_swap.description: FMS swaps afternoon delivery route between EV_028 (Priority) and EV_008 (Non-Priority); operator accepts business-continuity option.

case_4_pv_shortfall.description: Sudden cloud front drops rooftop PV output from 17.8 kW forecast to 4.2 kW actual during midday window.
